title: Datadog positioned as a Challenger in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Security Information and Event Management
summary: Datadog has been recognized as a Challenger in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Security Information and Event Management.
body_markdown:
Yanbing Li


Chief Product Officer


We’re excited to announce that Datadog has been positioned as a Challenger in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Security Information and Event Management.


We believe this placement reflects Datadog’s continued investment in building security products that let our customers outpace attackers from prevention to remediation in the AI era. Attackers move at machine speed, compressing the time to exploit vulnerabilities from months to hours. Agents have all but eliminated the barrier to launch campaigns that used to require nation-state level resources. Without the right tools and resources, these two factors can easily overwhelm a security operations center (SOC) team, burying them in alert queues while real threats sit undetected.


[Datadog Cloud SIEM](https://www.datadoghq.com/product/cloud-siem/) is an operating layer for the entire SecOps lifecycle with a stream-based detection engine, agentic SOC capabilities, and native SOAR in a single platform that enables security teams to detect, investigate, and remediate AI-driven threats.[Bits Security Analyst](https://www.datadoghq.com/product/ai/bits-security-analyst/) autonomously triages signals and escalates true positives for confirmation and response so SOC teams can fight alert fatigue and focus on real risks.[Bits Threat Hunting](https://www.datadoghq.com/blog/bits-threat-hunting/) turns emerging campaign reports into hypothesis-driven threat hunts that include the scope of the impact in the environment and new detections to deploy to catch new attacker activity in your environment. These features, combined with the observability and organizational context collected by our unified agent, give SOC teams the ability to identify threats as soon as they emerge and coordinate precise responses across the entire organization.


Magic Quadrant for Security Information and Event Management 2026 Magic Quadrant for Security Information and Event Management 2026


We believe this recognition reinforces our vision for the future of security operations: In the AI era, a SIEM must adapt to how your SOC operates, maintain detection coverage across increasing data volumes, and scale capacity without scaling headcount.


Customer feedback plays a key role in analyst evaluations. We are grateful to the security teams that continue to share their experience with Datadog. Their input helps us improve Cloud SIEM and stay focused on the detection, investigation, data management, and response challenges that matter most.


Learn more about[Datadog Cloud SIEM](https://www.datadoghq.com/product/cloud-siem/) and our integrated security platform.


Learn more about Datadog’s placement and read the full 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Security Information and Event Management.
